title: Bone regeneration in rabbit calvarial defects using PRGF and adipose -derived stem cells: histomorphometrical analysis
authors: Stumbras A, Kuliesius P, Darinskas A, Kubilius R, Zigmantaite V and Juodzbalys G. Regen Med. 2020 Apr; 15(4):1535-1549. doi: 10.2217/rme-2019-0123.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Combining PRGF and ADSCs boosts the bone graft regenerative potential at the earliest period of healing” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
